channel.title: Gospel News Access
channel.description: Original gospel, Christian and faith reporting from Gospel News Access.

item.title: Freda Payne Made Time Stand Still
item.description: At 84, in gold lamé and black lace, she sang nine legends back into a sold-out Los Angeles room, gave thanks to God from the stage, and delivered a triumph.

item.title: Taylor Swift takes a sixth Video of the Year at the VMAs; Madonna wins seven
item.description: The 2026 MTV Video Music Awards ran Sunday night from the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. Snoop Dogg hosted. Madonna opened the show for the first time in twenty-three years.

item.title: The gospel world this week: Tasha goes unscripted, Anthony Brown returns, Gaither gets a tribute
item.description: A 34-track live album out of Atlanta, a seventh record after a three-year silence, and a Nashville red carpet for the Gaither songbook. What actually happened in gospel music this month.

item.title: Last call: the 41st Stellar Awards leave broadcast syndication on Sunday
item.description: The syndication window that has carried the ceremony across local stations since September 5 closes September 27. If it has not aired in your market yet, this weekend is the end of the run.

item.title: The 41st Stellar Awards are still airing across the country, and the Doves are two weeks out
item.description: Lisa Knowles-Smith took five. Darrel Walls took Artist of the Year. The broadcast syndication window runs through September 27, and the 57th GMA Dove Awards follow on October 6 with a Richard Smallwood tribute.

item.title: Yom Kippur 2026 ended Monday night, closing the Ten Days of Repentance
item.description: The holiest day in the Jewish year began at sundown on Sunday, September 20 and ended at nightfall on Monday, September 21. It is observed with a fast of roughly 25 hours.
